name: garuda
description: GARUDA real-time airfare price index: API + dashboard. `pnpm start` sets up and runs everything.

scripts.start: pnpm install && pnpm run setup && pnpm run dev
scripts.setup: uv sync --directory backend && uv run --directory backend python -m app.bootstrap && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.dev: node scripts/check-ports.mjs && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "pnpm --dir frontend dev --port 5173 --strictPort"
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest && pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir frontend lint
